'''Pal-Nada''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]. He used his [[Force power/Legends|abilities]] to establish a lucrative [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-trafficking business on [[Jenenma]] during the years of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].
